Home/How to wear

Five ways
to wear it.

Every one starts the same way: lay it flat, fold it corner to corner. Here is what to do next.

Worn by you

Made to be worn.

One square, endless looks. Tie it on, knot it at the neck, or roll it into a headband — every colour works every way.

01On the headClassic Red
02Round the neckNavy
03As a headbandMustard

Start here

Fold it corner
to corner.

Lay it flat, print side down, and bring one corner to the opposite one. That triangle is where almost every style begins.

→
  1. 01

    Head

    Fold it into a triangle and tie it at the back of your head.

    1. Lay it flat and fold corner to corner into a triangle.
    2. Put the long edge across your forehead, point to the back.
    3. Tie the two ends over the point at the nape of your neck.
  2. 02

    Neck

    Tie a loose knot at the front. It lifts a plain t-shirt straight away.

    1. Fold into a triangle, then roll from the long edge to a 5 cm band.
    2. Wrap it round your neck, ends to the front.
    3. Tie a loose knot off to one side.
  3. 03

    Wrist

    Roll it thin, wrap it twice and tuck in the ends.

    1. Fold into a triangle and roll tightly into a thin cord.
    2. Wrap twice round your wrist.
    3. Tie a small knot and tuck the ends underneath.
  4. 04

    Bag

    Knot it around the strap or handle to add colour to any bag.

    1. Fold into a triangle and roll to a band.
    2. Loop it round the base of the handle.
    3. Tie a bow or a single knot and let the ends hang.
  5. 05

    Back pocket

    Let one corner hang out of your back pocket.

    1. Fold in half, then in half again.
    2. Tuck the folded square into a back pocket.
    3. Pull one corner out so the print shows.
